upstreamP1ThroughP14.meaning: The supplied verified package establishes P1-P14 phase coverage PASS over the upstream canonical scope. This state is preserved because the package HEAD is an ancestor of the live branch and the intervening delta did not modify P1-P14 implementation.
upstreamP1ThroughP14.doesNotMean: Every one of the 5730 requirements has already satisfied the stricter P15.1 per-row implementation/test/evidence/acceptance schema.

strictP15_1Traceability.meaning: These counts measure strict P15.1 row-level traceability closure only. They must not be presented as the total amount of upstream work already verified.

reconciliationDecision.correctedFact: The previously surfaced 1263 figure is a strict P15.1 row-level closure count, not the count of P1-P14 canonical requirements already covered by the verified upstream phase package.
reconciliationDecision.nextRule: Continue P15.1 from the existing strict traceability frontier. Preserve P1-P14 verified phase state, reuse its implementation/test evidence where a requirement can be source-bound, and promote a row to VERIFIED only when every existing P15.1 validator field is satisfied.
